pages.text: $(bold)Key Bindings$()$(br2)All PiranPort keys can be customized in Controls > Key Binds.$(br2)$(bold)Default Keys:$()$(br)• $(bold)P$(): Lock fire control target$(br)• $(bold)O$(): Cycle next target$(br)• $(bold)I$(): Cancel lock$(br)• $(bold)V$(): Recon aircraft view

$(bold)More Keys:$()$(br)• $(bold)U$(): Aircraft group management$(br)• $(bold)H$(): Auto-launch aircraft$(br)• $(bold)Y$(): Entity highlight toggle$(br)• $(bold)R$(): Ammo selection (with cannon)$(br)• $(bold)Shift+RMB$(): Artillery scope$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Rebind keys that conflict with other mods!
